_comment: MATHMON RECOVERY CENTER (MCR) interior. Background art: assets/backgrounds/village_recovery_interior.png (from 'Interior Mathmon Recovery Center (MCR).jpeg'); collision from tools/process_building_art.py. The nurse and the information desk are part of the painting, so their interactables are painted. Drawn at half size (15 x 9 tiles) so the painted nurse matches the characters' size. Background v2 has the nurse and receptionist painted out (tools/process_building_art.py); they are real NPCs now. capsules: drawn recovery capsules (game/overworld.py).
name: Mathmon Recovery Center

interactables.name: Nurse Hana
interactables.title: NURSE HANA
text: Welcome to the Mathmon Recovery Center! Our Recovery Chamber runs on maths.

interactables.name: information desk
interactables.title: TOURIST INFORMATION
text: Mathea has four worlds: Number Forest, the Algebra Cavern, the Geometry Kingdom and the Chronos Dimension.
Each world's camp has a Recovery Station. Solve problems there to heal on the road!

interactables.name: Recovery Capsule
interactables.title: RECOVERY CAPSULE
text: A resting AQUABIT floats in the healing liquid. Its pulse is steady. Almost ready to go home!

interactables.name: Recovery Capsule
interactables.title: RECOVERY CAPSULE
text: A resting PYRON floats in the healing liquid. Its flame is flickering back to full strength.

interactables.name: Recovery Capsule
interactables.title: RECOVERY CAPSULE
text: A resting VOLTIX floats in the healing liquid. Tiny sparks dance in the liquid. It's charging up!

npcs.name: Nurse Hana

any: Hello! I'm Nurse Hana. I'm checking on our patients.
Want to rest one of your MathMon in the Recovery Capsule? Solve my problems and it heals!

remarks: Every right answer powers the capsule.

npcs.name: Receptionist Ada
lines: Welcome to the Recovery Center! Talk to me at the counter, or find Nurse Hana on her rounds.
The capsule fits one MathMon at a time.
remarks: Please sign the guest book... in numbers!

npcs.name: Kai
lines: My VOLTIX lost to a wild DIVOWL. Division is hard when you're tired!
Nurse Hana asked me three questions. I got two - good enough for a nap.
remarks: I should practise my times tables.

npcs.name: Mia
lines: Did you know the capsule glows greener as your MathMon gets better?
I'm waiting for my AQUABIT. It swallowed a negative number.

npcs.name: Old Pell
lines: In my day the capsules ran on long division. You young ones have it easy!
Read the information desk. Knowledge is the best medicine.
